narrative.overview: A calm, incident-focused Grafana workspace where user impact is visible first and diagnostic depth is one deliberate step away.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Color communicates a condition, never decoration.

rules.name: The Native Surface Rule
rules.body: Grafana owns surfaces and depth; dashboard rows own information hierarchy.

dos: Do give every panel an operational decision to support.
Do expose missing telemetry as unknown.
donts: Don't use a neon security-operations-center aesthetic.
Don't use decorative gauges, maps, or vanity totals.
Don't create a wall of equal-weight cards.
Don't communicate status through color alone.
Don't add screenshot-only claims that are not backed by live telemetry.
